verdicts.reason: The two 320x50 banners are nearly identical. Both shrink the body copy to about 4px, so it can't be read, and in both the badges sit tight under the headline with no breathing room. In A, the sage circle is detached from the can and pushed behind the 'Find It Near You' button at the right edge, which looks like a mistake. B keeps the circle behind the can as in the original, so the product reads as one group and B is slightly more faithful.
